---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who hits it, and how often? Avoid
jumping straight to a solution — describe the user need first.

## Proposed solution

How would you like PromptOps to behave? UI mockups, API sketches or example
SDK usage are all welcome.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about? Why are they worse?

## Additional context

Related issues, links to similar features in other tools, or anything else
that helps frame the request.
